description: Integrate string model into main production simulation loop and implement net-billing deposit settlement option. Two major changes: (1) Auto-divide panels into strings based on MPPT voltage range, apply mismatch loss per hour in main production engine, allow user choice of optimizers; (2) Add net-billing deposit settlement mode to economics engine.
steps: Create function podziel_na_stringi(liczba_paneli, napiecie_mpp_panela, zakres_mppt_min, zakres_mppt_max) in backend/services/optimizer.py. It should calculate max panels per string = floor(zakres_mppt_max / napiecie_mpp_panela) and min panels = ceil(zakres_mppt_min / napiecie_mpp_panela). Then divide all panels into strings of appropriate length (evenly distributed). Return list of KonfiguracjaStringa objects.

Add new top-level function oblicz_roczna_produkcje_instalacji(panele_wyniki_zacienienia, moc_stc, wsp_temp, technologia, liczba_sekcji, dane_tmy, kat_nachylenia, azymut_panela, straty_systemowe, degradacja, rok_eksploatacji, stringi, z_optymalizatorami, moc_nominalna_falownika_w=None, noct=45.0, bifacial=False, bifacial_wspolczynnik=0.0, przeswit_nad_gruntem_m=0.5, albedo=0.2) in panel_performance.py. This function iterates over all hours. For each hour: if z_optymalizatorami=True, each panel works independently (current model, sum all panels). If z_optymalizatorami=False, group panels by string, compute shading coefficient per panel, apply oblicz_mismatch_stringa to get string-level power coefficient, then compute total string production. Return dict with roczna_kwh, miesieczna_kwh[12], per-panel results, string configuration info.

Update handle_shading_simulate in backend/api/handlers.py: (1) Accept new option 'falownik_id' to look up inverter MPPT range from inverters_database.json. (2) If falownik_id provided, auto-compute strings using podziel_na_stringi. (3) Pass z_optymalizatorami and stringi to the new production function. (4) Include string configuration in the response (which panels are in which string). (5) If no falownik_id, fall back to current per-panel-independent model.

Add new function analizuj_ekonomie_net_billing(produkcja_godzinowa_wh, zuzycie_godzinowe_wh, taryfa, magazyn, rok, marza_sprzedawcy=0.03) in backend/services/economics.py. Logic: for each hour, if there is surplus PV, its value (kwh * (RCE_netto - marza)) goes into deposit account (PLN). If there is deficit, cost of grid purchase is first subtracted from deposit balance. After 12 months (at end of year), unused deposit is refunded at 20% (80% lost). Track monthly deposit state. Return same structure as analizuj_ekonomie plus extra fields: depozyt_stan_miesieczny[12], depozyt_wplaty_roczne, depozyt_wykorzystane, depozyt_przepadlo, depozyt_zwrot_20_procent.

Update handle_economics_analyze in handlers.py: accept new parameter 'tryb_rozliczenia' with values 'sprzedaz_bezposrednia' (current default) or 'net_billing_depozyt'. When 'net_billing_depozyt', call the new function instead of analizuj_ekonomie.
Add unit tests for: podziel_na_stringi (test with known MPPT ranges and panel voltages), and analizuj_ekonomie_net_billing (test deposit accumulation, deduction, and 80% loss at year end).
acceptance_criteria: podziel_na_stringi correctly divides panels into strings respecting MPPT voltage window
String model in production engine: without optimizers, mismatch reduces string output; with optimizers, panels produce independently
Net-billing deposit: surplus value accumulates in PLN deposit, grid costs reduce deposit first, 80% of unused deposit is lost after 12 months
API handlers accept new parameters (falownik_id, tryb_rozliczenia, marza_sprzedawcy)
